## Overview

The head of the Flesh Architects — the being who oversees all experiments and reports to the Crimson Covenant's Inner Circle (and to ViF's Convocation of Fragments). Named for the first time in Elena Vance's journal found at Gamma-7, where she records overhearing his name: **J.B.**

J.B. is better known to Zan (Subject 242) as the crime lord "The Collector" — the man who mutilated his ears, renamed him, and sold him to the Flesh Architects. The sale was a transfer between his own identities: J.B. the crime lord acquiring subjects for J.B. the Chief Architect.

## Key Facts

- Identity: **J.B.** — the same J.B. (The Collector) who trained and sold Zan
- Ordered the decommissioning of Gamma-7
- Ordered consolidation of all monster integration research into the Primary Facility
- Rumored to have undergone extensive self-implantation — possibly no longer fully mortal
- Used his crime lord identity as a cover for talent acquisition and test subject procurement

## Secrets (GM Only)

- Zan does not know J.B. is the Chief Architect. He believes J.B. was a crime lord who sold him to the Architects. The truth — that the man who mutilated and renamed him was also the man who ran the Catalyst Project — is a devastating reveal for later.
- J.B. ordered the Catalyst Project and was personally aware of Subject 242's progress and escape.
- J.B. may have other "collector" identities across the continent — other fronts for the Flesh Architects, none knowing he is their ultimate leader.

## Plot Hooks

- J.B. is Zan's primary target for destruction and vengeance — made doubly personal by the truth
- J.B. knows Sophie's fate (Subject 241) and her current activities as Agent 241
